acks.title: Acknowledgements
acks.description:
We are deeply grateful to our mentors from RedHat Summer Camp, Kyndryl, JA Czech, Purkyňka High School and JIC, who gave us room to experiment, patiently shared their expertise and believed that Plantiful could genuinely help people. Their mentorship encouraged us to iterate faster, prototype new features and keep raising the bar for the experience we deliver.

We also want to thank the communities, partners, families and early users who shared feedback, tested imperfect builds and celebrated every milestone at our side. Your trust turns this journey into something bigger than a school project — it keeps us growing.

foreword.title: RedHat Summer Camp
foreword.description:
Plantiful was created during Red Hat Summer Camp 2022 where a week of product workshops pushed us to validate the idea, prototype the first flows and pitch in front of mentors.

Within a few hours we refined the story, the presentation and the first interface. The competition was strong, but we still took the win that convinced us the project had a future.
highlights: Formed the Plantiful founding team and validated the concept in 48 hours.
Won the Red Hat Summer Camp finale and secured ongoing mentorship.

kyndryl_challenge.title: Kyndryl Challenge
kyndryl_challenge.description:
The momentum from Red Hat carried us to the nationwide Kyndryl Challenge. Together with product mentors we turned the pitch deck into a roadmap, tested ideas with small nurseries and delivered our first working MVP.

Winning the challenge unlocked an internship where we could keep building Plantiful with professionals.
highlights: Built the first cross-platform MVP with Kyndryl mentors.
Won the challenge and earned an internship to continue development.

kyndryl.title: Kyndryl Internship
kyndryl.description:
During the Kyndryl internship we rebuilt the prototype with production tooling, automated plant care suggestions and designed integrations for partner nurseries.

The experience taught us how to run continuous discovery while shipping a polished mobile experience.
highlights: Automated care plans for 150+ plants with real nursery data.
Shipped cloud architecture that scales to partner greenhouses.

ja_expo.title: JA Expo
ja_expo.description:
We brought Plantiful to JA Expo to test it with thousands of visitors and collect feedback on physical prototypes.

Presenting on stage helped us refine our story, and the fair introduced new partners who joined the pilot.
highlights: Gathered feedback from 2,000+ visitors during live demos.
Signed new beta testers and marketplace partners on-site.

fekt_eeict.title: FEKT EEICT
fekt_eeict.description:
We documented our learnings in a research paper for the FEKT EEICT conference where we presented the data we gathered from early pilots.

The committee awarded our work and encouraged us to keep bridging academic insight with product development.
highlights: Published our methodology and findings in a peer-reviewed paper.
Received the FEKT EEICT award for applied research.

release.title: Open-source Release
release.description:
We finally open-sourced the Plantiful experience so others can build plant care experiments faster.

The release bundles the mobile app, knowledge base and design system we matured along the journey.
highlights: Open-sourced the Plantiful codebase and design system.
Documented contributor workflows and the first public roadmap.
